name: fuzzy_match_map_normalized_positions
notes: Whitespace-normalized position mapper (fuzzy_match.c vs LIVE tools/fuzzy_match.py). KNOWN DIVERGENCE (documented, inputs avoid it): the 'nearest normalized position' fallback for an unmapped match start picks the smallest ORIGINAL index in LIVE but the smallest mapped VALUE in the C port — these can differ when orig_to_norm holds distinct out-of-order values. All gate inputs keep match starts inside norm_to_orig_start so the fallback never fires; also avoided: ns>nlen with no qualifying mapping (LIVE raises ValueError).
